scenes.say: Flip a coin ten times and it can lie to your face. Flip it five thousand times and it can't.
The law of large numbers: the more you repeat, the closer the real rate gets to the true probability.
Careful: it's about the rate, not about shortfalls being paid back. The coin has no memory.
A small edge only shows up after many repetitions. Judge strategies on big samples.

takeaway: A small edge only shows up after many repetitions. Judge strategies on big samples.
